title: 1. The Trail That Did Not Walk
description: Chapter 1 of 3 of “The Case of the Missing Star”. Read in order.

cover.alt: The Case of the Missing Star

illustration.alt: They decorate for a party; the star disappears, leaving an empty hook and two trails in the mud.

lines: Luna and her little brother Nico help Pico the stork decorate the station for a party.
blocks.title: Getting ready

lines: The star hangs from a loose bow. Wind shakes the ribbon as Pico moves his cart past.
blocks.title: The hanging star

lines: When the children look back, the hook is empty. The star has vanished while they were busy.
blocks.title: It's gone!

lines: They spot two different trails in the mud: small pawprints towards the garden and long lines the other way.
blocks.title: Two trails

variants.retryFeedback: Look at the hook first, then at the trails on the ground.

variants.prompt: What must they learn before saying someone took it?
variants.retryFeedback: Look at the hook first, then at the trails on the ground.

illustration.alt: They follow pawprints to a cat, search by the bench, and return to the other trail.

lines: Nico chooses the pawprints, and Luna follows. Whoever passed here might offer a clue.
blocks.title: Trail to the garden

lines: The tracks lead to a black-and-white cat. Its small paws look like the prints on the path.
blocks.title: The cat by the bench

lines: The children check beside the bench and underneath it, but they do not find the missing star.
blocks.title: Not here

lines: They return to the fork to try the other trail. They still need an explanation.
blocks.title: Back to the crossing

variants.prompt: Where do the little pawprints lead?

options.text: To the cat beside the bench

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! To the cat beside the bench.
variants.retryFeedback: Pawprints show who passed; check whether they also found the decoration.

variants.prompt: What can they say after searching beside the bench?

options.text: They did not find it there

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! They did not find it there.
variants.retryFeedback: Pawprints show who passed; check whether they also found the decoration.

illustration.alt: Dotted ribbon beside wheel marks leads them to a window with a huge shadow.

lines: Luna notices a scrap of blue ribbon caught beside the two long lines in the mud.
blocks.title: The ribbon scrap

lines: White dots cover the scrap, just like the star's ribbon. This is something they can compare.
blocks.title: The same dots

lines: The lines lead them to the wooden workshop. Luna keeps the scrap as they approach the door.
blocks.title: To the workshop

lines: An enormous shadow fills the glowing window. Nico pauses: what could be making that shape?
blocks.title: A huge shadow

variants.prompt: What pattern is on the blue ribbon scrap?
variants.retryFeedback: Compare the ribbon pattern with the one at the beginning.

variants.prompt: What links the workshop trail to the star?

options.text: Matching ribbon beside the long lines

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! Matching ribbon beside the long lines.
variants.retryFeedback: Compare the ribbon pattern with the one at the beginning.

stork.definition: A bird with a long beak and long legs.

ribbon.definition: A narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decorating.

bow.definition: A knot with loops that can be loosened by pulling an end.

hook.definition: A curved piece used to hang something.

pawprints.definition: Marks left by an animal’s feet.

trail.definition: Marks that show where something has passed.

workshop.definition: A place where things are made or repaired.

shadow.definition: A dark shape made when something blocks light.

scrap.definition: A small piece left or torn from something.

explanation.definition: An account of how or why something happened.

compare.definition: To look for similarities and differences.
